scene.head: with_body
scene.ofreeRecent: the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; a tiny neighborhood repair cafe with a sunlit workbench and a hand-cranked mechanical ticket dispenser — she frees a jammed paper roll from the dispenser using two wooden clothes pegs; a dim jazz bar with a grand piano — standing; a quiet seaside tidal-rock bathing terrace with shallow clear pools — she uses a small floating balance to divide smooth pebbles into equal piles; a Yangtze ferry landing with moored junks under red sails and coiled ropes on the wooden pier — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a sunlit white marble temple — sitting on the ground; an empty sunny laundromat folding counter beside a large round washing-machine door — she compares two freshly paired socks by folding them into equal rectangles; a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; long mossy stone steps climbing to the carved gate of a mountain sect — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — coils the cable of a microphone loosely around her hand; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — standing; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — lying on her front
